title: JointPoses
description: The pose of every joint of a robot model at one set of joint positions, as the physics replica answers forward kinematics (`POST /fk`, and `fk --envelope` on its command line): the position in meters and the orientation as a unit quaternion (w, x, y, z) of each joint, all in one declared frame. The poses are listed from the root of the chain to the tip; a tool centre point asked for with an offset comes last under the name `tcp`. The quaternion of a pose is a unit quaternion within 1e-5 (checked by the clients, a schema cannot express it). The schema is closed.

frame.description: The frame the poses are written in: the root link of the model, which is the base of the robot.

checked.description: True when the joint positions were checked against the limits of the model before the poses were computed.
